$comment: Design defaults of the personnel module (G-57). Not football facts: each block names the bible leaf that states it as a starting value or an Assumption. Kept out of .ts because league source holds no number but 0 and 1 (P1.1.2).

template53.$comment: M1.3.1 rule 1: starting pro 53. 'These are a design default, not a fact' (Assumption, labelled so on screen).

tierShares.$comment: M3.1.2 rule 1: league-wide share of rostered players per colour tier (starting values, Assumption).

tierCuts.$comment: D6.2.1 colour-tier scale: Blue ISS 65 and up, Red 55, Purple 45, Orange 35 (starting values). M3.1.2 makes them per position; calibrateTierCuts() refits from the shares above.

contactExposure.$comment: M6.2.3: injury exposure per rep as a share of a game snap, walkthrough, jog-through, thud, live (starting multipliers 0.05, 0.2, 0.6, 1.0).

contactTechniqueGain.$comment: M6.2.3: tackling and finishing improve only in thud (partly) and live (fully). 'Partly' is read as half (Assumption, P-57-7).

battleDecisionDay.$comment: M6.2.2 rule 3: default decision dates (tuning knob, Assumption): quarterback the day after the second preseason game, other starters the day after the third, specialists the week of cutdown (-1 means the cutdown week).

preseasonStyle.$comment: M6.3.1 rule 1: series starters play per preseason game by camp style (Assumption). 'light' plays one or two series in game two (two used); 'traditional' plays one series, a quarter (about three series), a half (about six series); series counts for a quarter and a half are this module's reading (P-57-8).

staffCalendar.$comment: M6.1.1 rule 5: the staff's starting calendar for a three-preseason-game year, day 0 = veterans' report day, opener on day 47 (Assumption built inside rule 4). Three padded runs of 3 in weeks 2 and 3 (9), 2 padded in each of the next two preseason weeks (13), one in the third preseason week and one in the bye week (15), one kept in reserve. Days off: 9, the least that meets rule 4 with games on days 24, 31 and 38 under this module's reading (P-57-3).

facilityDayHours.$comment: M6.1.1 rule 4: hours on site per day type in the staff draft (Assumption, P-57-3); checked against the facility limit by key.
